component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.reports = 0 m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.5 m.timer.observeField("fire", "onRerun") end sub
sub onReady() m.task.cmd = 1 end sub
' Re-run once, after the first run has returned. sub onRerun() print "SCENE: re-running, state=" + m.task.state m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) m.reports++ print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() if m.reports = 1 then m.timer.control = "start" if m.reports = 2 then m.top.done = true end sub
